# Accessibility & Responsividade Checklist: Player Cinematográfico de Quadros

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos de acessibilidade (descrições
narrativas, reduced-motion, teclado, leitores de tela) e de responsividade (320–2560 px,
orientação, áreas seguras). Os requisitos estão completos, claros, consistentes e
mensuráveis?
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | Contrato: [player-ui-contract.md](../contracts/player-ui-contract.md) | Constituição: [constitution.md](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Completude dos Requisitos

- [x] CHK001 Is the mechanism for exposing each frame's long narrative description specified (visible long description vs `aria-describedby` vs live region), and is a concise alt also required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012] — `aria-describedby`/live + alt curto (FR-012)
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for reproducing text embedded in images (dialogue/lettering) verbatim in the description? [Gap, Spec §FR-012] — FR-012 reprodução literal
- [x] CHK003 Are the live region's politeness, atomicity, and update cadence specified, including debouncing to avoid announcement spam? [Gap, UI Contract §Acessibilidade] — polite + atomic + debounce ≥500 ms
- [x] CHK004 Is the behavior defined for screen-reader users when auto-advance would produce continuous announcements? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012/§FR-017] — anúncios coalescidos pelo debounce; pausa disponível
- [x] CHK005 Is a visible focus indicator requirement defined for all controls (WCAG 2.4.7 / `:focus-visible`)? [Gap, Spec §FR-010] — FR-010 + UI contract
- [x] CHK006 Are minimum touch-target dimensions specified for all controls? [Gap, Spec §FR-010] — ≥44×44 px (AAA)
- [x] CHK007 Are text contrast and legibility requirements specified? [Gap, Constitution §VI] — SC-017 AAA + tabela WCAG
- [x] CHK008 Are zoom / text-resize (200%) and reflow requirements specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-009] — UI contract (WCAG 1.4.4/1.4.10)
- [x] CHK009 Are safe-area (notch) requirements present in the functional requirements, not only in the contract/constitution? [Traceability, Spec §FR-009] — FR-009
- [x] CHK010 Is the language declaration (`lang`) and the description language specified for screen readers? [Gap] — FR-012 + UI contract
- [x] CHK011 Is the progress indicator's accessible semantics (values and labels) specified? [Gap, UI Contract] — `role="progressbar"` + valores
- [x] CHK012 Is "descrição narrativa detalhada, equivalente à experiência visual" quantified with minimum content criteria? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012/§SC-013] — personagens/cenário/ação/atmosfera + texto
- [x] CHK013 Is "animações/transições reduzidas ou removidas" clarified (which are removed, which replaced, which are essential)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011] — todas viram corte instantâneo
- [x] CHK014 Are "sem cortes de enquadramento nem rolagem horizontal" defined measurably against aspect-ratio and letterboxing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009] — `object-fit: contain` + letterbox
- [x] CHK015 Are the SC-005 viewport/orientation targets mapped to concrete test conditions (including the 320 px and 2560 px extremes)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005] — Matriz de viewports (quickstart)
- [x] CHK016 Is "mesma integridade narrativa" defined in measurable terms across devices? [Ambiguity, Spec §US3] — SC-005 define sequência/corte/rolagem/controles
- [x] CHK017 Is the conflict resolved between auto-advance (FR-017) and reduced-motion "no automatic animation beyond a static frame" (SC-006)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-017/§SC-006] — FR-011
- [x] CHK018 Are reduced-motion requirements consistent across the spec, UI contract, and constitution? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, UI Contract, Constitution §VI] — consistentes (redução/alternativa)
- [x] CHK019 Do keyboard requirements address conflicts between player shortcuts and browser/OS defaults (Space/arrow scrolling)? [Gap, UI Contract §Atalhos] — `preventDefault` + precedência
- [x] CHK020 Is the "avoid hover-only interactions" principle reflected as an explicit requirement in the spec, not only in the constitution/contract? [Traceability, Constitution §III] — FR-010
- [x] CHK021 Is the layout behavior on orientation change specified (preserve the current frame, no restart)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §US3] — UI contract preserva quadro
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for very small viewports (<320 px, e.g. PWA windows) and ultra-wide displays? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap] — UI contract (<320/>2560)
- [x] CHK023 Is the behavior specified when an image fails to load (broken frame) for both visual and screen-reader users? [Coverage, Gap] — edge case placeholder + descrição
- [x] CHK024 Are reduced-motion requirements defined for all motion sources (CSS transitions and any script-driven motion)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011] — FR-011 (CSS + script)
- [x] CHK025 Is the reduced-data / low-performance device scenario addressed in the accessibility/responsiveness requirements? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions] — FR-031
- [x] CHK026 Does each accessibility FR trace to a WCAG 2.2 success criterion? [Traceability] — resolvido: FR-011→2.2.2 (A) + 2.3.3 (AAA, avanço manual); FR-012→3.1.1/3.1.2; FR-014→4.1.3; linha US4 corrigida
- [x] CHK027 Are touch and keyboard navigation requirements traceable to both a functional requirement and a testable acceptance scenario? [Traceability, Spec §FR-010] — FR-010 + US3 AS3/AS4

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- **Review 2026-09-23**: revisão por agente + sessão de `/speckit.clarify`; todos os critérios passaram a ser satisfeitos pelas atualizações de `spec.md` e `player-ui-contract.md`.
- **Re-review 2026-09-23 (2ª passada)**: CHK001, CHK025 e CHK026 reabertos e resolvidos após `/speckit.clarify` — `alt` obrigatório, FR-031/SC-020 e tabela WCAG corrigida.
- **Re-review 2026-09-23 (3ª passada, agente independente)**: CHK026 reaberto e **resolvido** — tabela WCAG corrigida (FR-011→2.2.2/2.3.3; FR-012→3.1.1/3.1.2; FR-014→4.1.3) e matriz US4 ajustada. Demais itens confirmados. Achado adicional: nível de ducking (40%) e crossfade do mix (300 ms) só existem em contratos/data-model, não no spec (aceito pela política de linguagem neutra).
